svg.title: RMR control box in the gantry
svg.text: RMR control box: mount in the gantry

Four cast corner brackets hold the box to the gantry's lower members; it comes out by lifting 38 and sliding forward under the front middle member. Views 1:5, detail C 1:1, printed at 100 %. Millimetres; z up from the base plate's underside.

The gantry (owner, 2026-10-19)
2020, 6 mm slot, so the kit's M5 roll-in T-nuts fit. The members run left to right in the
planes of the box's front and back faces; the lower ones stand on the same rubber feet as the
box (B08B87SRRG), their bottom faces level with the base plate's underside. Measured face to
face: front, lower to middle 230 and middle to top 130; back, center to top 38; front and back top
at one height. The front middle member moves up to 315 over the lower one, 45 under the top one.
Mount
4 spare cast corner brackets from the kit (40 bought, 32 in the frame, 1 is the saw stop), one at
each lower post, front and back: the vertical leg on the panel, held by the post's bottom panel
screw at z 30 in a 5.5 x 10 vertical slot, so the bracket seats on the member ±2.2; the horizontal leg
on the member's top face, one M5 into a roll-in T-nut. The front
and back lower panels lose their bottom ring screw: the member backs their bottom edge. Not
structural, and no bond: anodize insulates, so PE stays on the trunk to the gantry bar (ADR-0009).
Taking it out
Unplug the mains cord first. Free every cable that leaves the box: the door cable is wired to X1
inside, through the M20 gland, so free it at the door (S1, H1); the field and motor cables, the Mega
USB, and the PE trunk at the gantry bar. Take out the 4 member-side screws; the brackets stay on the
box. Lift 38, so the feet clear a lower member by 5; any lift from 33 to 47.4 works.
Slide it out forward: its top (z 287.6 with the top panel's screw heads) passes 9.5 under the front
middle member. Out the back it would pass 16.5 under the back center member, behind the mains.
Checked by GantryChecks()
Nothing proud of the front or back face (screw heads, grommet flanges, gland, PE stud, brackets)
meets a member; lifted, each face keeps 43.3 (front) and 24.6 (back) under its next member up.
Brackets on the posts, off the panel windows, clear of the gland and the PE stud. ScrewFits()
passes the three mount screws.
Gantry feet
8, on M5 screws into roll-in T-nuts in the lower members' bottom slots. The length lands the tip
4.2 to 5.5 past the slot face, so it needs the foot's stack under the head: measure a foot.
OPEN
mount bracket holes: at 10 from the corner the two socket heads overlap 2.85 in the corner, as in every frame bracket; measure a bracket
gantry foot screw length: the depth of the foot's washer (GantryFootStack)
